evidence: Ti(OMe)4 (95%, Aldrich) and Co(acac)3 (Alfa Aesar) were evaporated from open boats inside the reactor at 130 °C and 155 °C, respectively. Water was evaporated in an external reservoir at room temperature and ozone was produced with a Wedeco Ozomatic Modular 4 HC ozone generator from oxygen (99.999%, Linde Gas). The reactor was operated under a pressure of about 10 mbar using nitrogen (made on site by a Nitrox UHPN 3000 generator, rated purity of 99.9995%) as a carrier and purging gas.
